info.description: One published uniform catalogue. ⚠ `file` IS THE CATALOGUE ITSELF, now held in Strapi media rather than as a path into the site's public directory — a new edition is an upload, not a deploy. `originHref` records where the school publishes the same document, which is provenance and stays a plain URL because it is not ours to host. ⚠ `pages` AND `size` DESCRIBE THE FILE and are stated on the card; they are transcribed rather than computed because the card quotes the document, not the upload.
